messages:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT ALERT - spike in 5xxs from inference-api (/v1/embeddings) across eu-west and us-central, paging #incidents :rotating_light:

Alex R: seeing a flood of schema-mismatch errors, clients requesting embeddings but responses look like chat text. 5xx rate ~12% for last 3 mins.

Maya D: tagging @Sasha O (oncall) to take lead. can someone paste example logs?

Sasha O: oncall - taking. quick question: is this a runtime regression or routing? any recent alias changes?

Eli K: quick dump of a sample failing trace:
```
ERROR handler: output_type_mismatch - expected: embeddings, got: text
request: POST /v1/embeddings {"model_alias":"embed-main"}
route_decision: alias->pinned_version v12-instruct (alias metadata:interface=embeddings)
fallback_chain: primary:v12-emb-q3 -> fallback:region:eu-west->v12-chat -> returned: chat.text
stack: router->policy:economy_fallback->variant_map
```

Alex R: oh ugh. looks like alias "embed-main" resolves to v12-instruct in the control plane (someone pinned the wrong version). fallback policy then routed across region to a chat-optimized variant which returns text payloads -> handler 500s.

Maya D: who last modified "embed-main" alias? @PlatformBot any ACL / recent changes?

PlatformBot: alias:update event: user=mike.product, time=3187654209, change=pinned_version->v12-instruct, note="quick rollback test"

Sasha O: ok that explains it. mitigation plan: 1) revert alias to v12-emb-q3 2) temporarily disable cross-region fallback for embeddings 3) reduce traffic to hosted tier for EU to avoid customer impact. I'll coordinate.

Alex R: executing revert now: `/api/internal/aliases/assign embed-main -> v12-emb-q3 --force`

PlatformBot: alias assign accepted, rolling to control-plane. change_id=chg-7832.

Maya D: disabling routing policy: `PATCH /platform/policies/economy_fallback {"interfaces": ["gen","chat"], "disabled_for": "embeddings"}` pushed.

Eli K: monitoring logs and traces. confirming initial 2xxs resume for a sample tenant...

Sasha O: starting traffic ramp-down for EU hosted tier to 30% to limit blast radius. oncall -> I'll keep watch for 15m.

CS Rep: P0 customer (AcmeSearch) reported degraded embeddings causing search quality drop and alerted support. Notifying them we are reverting alias and will follow up with RCA.

Alex R: after revert we see 5xxs drop to 0.8% and embedding response types restored to correct vector payload. rolling window: 10m post-change looks stable.

Maya D: good. immediate customer impact: search queries returned text blobs for ~17 minutes across EU; affected customers: AcmeSearch, DataFlow Inc., Researchly. CS has sent an incident banner.

Eli K: preliminary root cause: lack of alias->interface compatibility validation in control plane UI + no guard on rapid pin changes. owner of change (mike.product) was testing and didn't realize interface mismatch.

Sasha O: immediate action items assigned:
- Alex R: lead RCA + timeline (due EOD)
- Eli K: add runtime validation in router to assert model.interface == alias.expected_interface (PR + unit tests)
- Platform team (Maya D): add UI warning and require a two-step confirm for pins that change interface type
- CS Rep: follow-up emails to affected customers, offer data-loss mitigation if any

Maya D: creating incident ticket and postmortem draft. tagging for escrow: severity=SEV2, impact=partial (embeddings degraded for EU), mitigated=true.

Alex R: note for postmortem: we hit an emergent fallback loop: pinned wrong variant -> fallback policy chooses best-performing compatible architecture (chat) across region -> returned incompatible payload -> client handler 500s. This should be classed as a "routing/alias guard" problem, not runtime bug.

Sasha O: handoff to day shift @Maya D for follow-up and long-term remediation tracking. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and will re-open if error rate climbs >2%. :white_check_mark:

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. closed to active pager at 3187654380. Logs archived to /incidents/3187654321.

Maya D: thanks all. next steps: meeting at 11:30 to go over RCA action items. I'll ping calendar invite. :calendar:
